**Ludora - the Client for all Game Clients** · Release 0.7.8

### What's new
- **New update dialog in Ludora's style:** clicking the green update button now opens Ludora's own dialog (instead of the system window) with what's new in the update and a progress bar. Clicking the “Update available” notification opens it too.
- **Steam game updates start right away:** “Update” now tells Steam directly to start the update (like Steam's remote download on the website) instead of just opening Steam. If Steam isn't running yet, Ludora starts it in the background. Requires being signed in to Steam in Ludora (Friends → Steam).
- **Clearer friends list:** the launcher tabs only show their logos (name on hover), and the launcher name no longer repeats in the status line.

### Downloads
| System | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 | `Ludora-Setup-0.7.8.exe` |
| macOS (Apple Silicon M1–M4) | `Ludora-0.7.8-arm64.dmg` (or `.zip`) |
| macOS (Intel) | `Ludora-0.7.8-x64.dmg` (or `.zip`) |
| Linux (any distribution) | `Ludora-0.7.8-x86_64.AppImage` |
| Debian / Ubuntu | `Ludora-0.7.8-amd64.deb` |

The files are not code-signed: on Windows click **More info → Run anyway**, on macOS **right-click → Open** on the first start.
